title: Incidents already listed on the status page
author: Kai Moreno
content:
# Purpose
This page is newer than the severity matrix. When both apply, this page wins.

# Already listed
When a customer reports an incident already listed on the Redwood status page, do not open a second incident.

An incident already listed on the Redwood status page is priority P3 with first response 1bd.

Do not add the label escalated. Engineering is already engaged through the status-page incident.
